relations.object: Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala at Benaras
relations.evidence: In 1904, he joined Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala at Benaras, where he studied philosophy and linguistics

relations.subject: Sukhlal Sanghvi

relations.subject: Sukhlal Sanghvi
relations.evidence: In 1922, he joined Puratattva Mandir of Gujarat Vidyapith as professor of Indian philosophy.

relations.subject: Sukhlal Sanghvi
relations.evidence: Here he edited Sanamatitarka of Siddhasena Divakara in five volumes containing valuable indices and appendices. He was assisted by Pandit Bechardasji in this task.

relations.subject: Sukhlal Sanghvi
relations.evidence: From 1934 to 1944 he was the Chair of Jain Philosophy at Benaras Hindu University.

relations.subject: Sukhlal Sanghvi
relations.evidence: After retirement from Banaras Hindu University in 1944, he came back to Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan where he worked with Jain monk Acarya Jinavijayaji.
